summary: Systemic: ~60 call sites do `setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "...")`, and extractError() returns the API route's raw `error` field. API routes emit developer strings that therefore reach users verbatim: "Not authenticated" (56x), "Invalid group DID" (42x), "locked", "csrf", "rkey is required", "Upstream PDS returned 502", "Upstream returned no record reference", "TokenInvalid", "Invalid authFactorToken".
fix: Add a single toUserMessage(err, fallback) mapper in src/lib/utils that maps known codes (401/not authenticated -> "Your session expired. Sign in again.", csrf -> "Refresh the page and try again.", upstream/5xx -> "Couldn't reach your account's server. Try again in a minute.", 413 -> "That file is too large (max 5 MB).") and only passes through messages explicitly marked user-safe. Use it at every setError site.
